actual: The C-012-RL1 immutable input-bundle suspend reader rejects the entire authoritative suspend_d sidecar whenever suspend_timing is non-null. The frozen manifest explicitly defines suspend_timing NULL as full-day and non-null as an intraday window. The daily HMM bundle must keep all rows schema-validated as suspend_type S, mark only full-day rows as daily unavailable, preserve intraday rows as non-blocking daily observations, and fail closed on unknown suspend types, duplicate full-day keys, manifest/hash drift, or malformed timing without changing model, seed, folds, thresholds, DB, runtime, or source files.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
